hero.headline: Famous for Flavor
hero.sub: Sprinkles Ice Cream Shoppe is a family friendly shoppe on Township Line Road in Elkins Park. The house line is Famous for Flavor. You come in, you pick a scoop, and you stay long enough to enjoy the company of others. Butter pecan, death by chocolate, moose tracks, cookies & cream, pistachio, and cotton candy are on the board.

items.title: Classic scoops
items.text: Butter pecan, cookies & cream, and pistachio are the familiar names people ask for by habit. The shoppe scoops them as ice cream, not as a flight or a concept. You point, they pack the cup or the cone.

items.title: The louder flavors
items.text: Death by chocolate, moose tracks, and cotton candy sit on the same board. Famous for Flavor is the shoppe's own line, and those three are the ones that sound like it.

items.title: A family friendly shoppe
items.text: Sprinkles calls itself a family friendly ice cream shoppe. The visit is scoop, sit, and enjoy the company of others. Cakes are part of the shoppe's name on the door: ice cream shops, ice cream cakes.

story.heading: Township Line Road, scooped
paragraphs: Elkins Park already knows the shoppe. Famous for Flavor is printed in the shoppe's own language, and the board backs it with butter pecan, death by chocolate, moose tracks, cookies & cream, pistachio, and cotton candy. The work is ice cream, served in a room meant for families.

A visit is not a tasting menu. You walk in, you choose a flavor that already has a name, and you stay. Monday the shoppe is closed. The rest of the week the door is for scoops and the people who came with you.

items.title: Read the board
items.text: Flavors are named, not coded. Butter pecan, death by chocolate, moose tracks, cookies & cream, pistachio, and cotton candy are the ones we can stand behind from their list.

items.title: Get the scoop packed
items.text: The shoppe packs ice cream the ordinary way: cup or cone, the flavor you asked for. Famous for Flavor is the standard they put on the work.

items.title: Stay and enjoy the room
items.text: Sprinkles asks you to relax and enjoy the company of others. The shoppe is built for a family visit, not a grab-and-vanish window.

feature.heading: Famous for Flavor, on purpose
feature.text: The shoppe does not hide behind a short seasonal list. Death by chocolate and moose tracks sit next to pistachio and butter pecan. The board is the product, and the product is ice cream.

spotlight.heading: Ice cream cakes belong here too
spotlight.text: The shoppe's own title pairs ice cream shops with ice cream cakes. A family visit can be a scoop tonight or a cake for the table. Either way the line is the same: Famous for Flavor.

items.title: Butter pecan
items.text: A named classic on the Sprinkles board. Scoop it in the shoppe on Township Line Road.

items.title: Death by chocolate
items.text: One of the louder house flavors. Famous for Flavor, packed in a cup or a cone.

items.title: Moose tracks
items.text: On the same board as cookies & cream, pistachio, and cotton candy.
